description: Retrieve the stages of a HyperExecute task (cache/prerun/scenario/etc.). Pass a stageId to return just that one stage. Stages are keyed by their parent task, so taskId is required.

stageId.description: Optional: return only the stage with this ID

taskId.description: The HyperExecute task ID whose stages to fetch

name: getHyperExecuteStage
title: Get HyperExecute Stage
